environment.description: Express application deployed on a single EC2 instance behind an AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB). The NLB operates at Layer 4 (TCP) and performs no request inspection. The application is accessed directly via the NLB DNS name. CORS is not configured (defaults to allowing all origins for simple requests). No API gateway or reverse proxy with request filtering is present. The SameSite=lax cookie attribute allows POST-based CSRF from top-level navigations.
